title: spring-web 5.3.39 has 2 known vulnerabilities
technical_impact: OSV lists GHSA-4gc7-5j7h-4qph, GHSA-4wrc-f8pq-fpqp for this exact version. Spring Framework DataBinder Case Sensitive Match Exception; Pivotal Spring Framework contains unsafe Java deserialization methods
business_impact: spring-web 5.3.39, a library the system depends on, has publicly known security flaws. Attackers read these lists too.
recommendation: Upgrade org.springframework:spring-web to a version without these advisories and re-test the features that use it.

title: Spring Framework 5.3.39 is past its end of life (2024-08-31)
technical_impact: Release cycle 5.3 of spring-framework gets no security or bug fixes since 2024-08-31. The newest cycle is 7.0.
business_impact: Part of the system runs on Spring Framework 5.3.39, which its maker stopped fixing on 2024-08-31. New security holes will stay open, and auditors and insurers usually flag this.
recommendation: Plan an upgrade of Spring Framework to a supported release (7.0 or another supported cycle).

title: 8 complex files change far more often than the rest
technical_impact: These files combine high branching with frequent edits: the places where defects and merge conflicts concentrate.
business_impact: A small set of files absorbs most of the changes and most of the risk. Every new feature that touches them costs more and breaks more often.
recommendation: Cover these files with tests first, then split them along their responsibilities before any larger migration.

title: Java 11 reaches end of life on 2027-10-31
technical_impact: Release cycle 11 of eclipse-temurin stops receiving fixes within a year.
business_impact: Within a year, Java will stop getting security fixes. Upgrading now is cheaper than in a hurry later.
recommendation: Schedule the upgrade of Java before 2027-10-31.
